production.text:
Get an Agent run
Copy page

Retrieve an Agent run by ID.

GET
/
agent
/
runs
/
{id}
Try it
Use this endpoint to poll a run until it reaches completed, failed, or cancelled.
Get your Exa API key
Create a key in the dashboard. New accounts start with free credits.
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Path Parameters
​
id
stringrequired

Agent run ID.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

Response
200
application/json

Agent run

​
id
stringrequired

Agent run ID. New run IDs are returned with the agent_run_ prefix.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

​
object
stringrequired
Allowed value: "agent_run"
​
status
enum<string>required
Available options: queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled 
​
stopReason
enum<string> | nullrequired

Why the run stopped. null while the run is queued or running.

Available options: schema_satisfied, budget_reached, stopped, error, cancelled 
​
createdAt
string<date-time>required

When the run was created

​
completedAt
string<date-time>required
​
request
object | nullrequired

Canonicalized request fields stored with the run.

Show child attributes

​
output
objectrequired

Show child attributes

​
usage
objectrequired

Show child attributes

​
costDollars
objectrequired

Show child attributes
